subject: planner: fix RANGE COLUMNS partition prune gives wrong result with special collation (#57344)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent focusing on planner partition pruning. The change switches multi-column RANGE COLUMNS pruning to `ranger.DetachCondAndBuildRangeForPartition` (disables string sort-key conversion / consecutive range merging) and uses per-range collators when comparing against partition `LESS THAN` bounds, with a new regression test covering special collations. No remaining Blocker/High correctness or SQL-semantics issues found within the planner scope touched by this commit.
